title: FEniCSx and FMI integration surfaces that run without their runtimes
note: Every mutation here is killed by a test that needs neither FEniCSx nor fmpy (the boundary reader, the series check, the slab model, the environment lock policy, the header check; the FMU build needs only a C compiler), so the agent-substrate shards can run it. The runtime-dependent halves run in the harness-integrations workflow, where the runtime is REQUIRED. FB9-FB16 attack the unit definitions read for D-2026-128: the boundary admitted a unit by its name, so a K with a Celsius offset, a W with the dimension of energy, or a K with no definition at all crossed as the harness's own. FB17 attacks the encoding check added for D-2026-129, which the hosted fuzz campaign found: an unknown codec in the XML declaration raised LookupError out of the boundary.
